name: Dick Nash
features: fair skin, fair hair parted, light eyes, narrow face, prominent ears, slight build, quick restless energy
bio: R.G.J. Nash — no relation to Archie Frazer-Nash — built specials that were the terror of the hills, and named one of them exactly that. The Terror took fastest time at Shelsley Walsh in 1932 and broke the Brooklands Test Hill record the same year, and he held Lewes at a flat twenty seconds. Between sprints he was rescuing First World War aeroplanes nobody else wanted; the Nash Collection is now scattered through Britain’s national aviation museums.
